checklist.text: Decide: legal marriage in Scotland (statutory notice + 2 witnesses) or symbolic/name-change ceremony
Set overall budget and rough allocation by category
Agree the four guests and send save-the-date
Draft ceremony vision doc: mood, colours, must-haves, non-negotiables
If legal: submit Marriage Notice to Scottish district registrar (min. 29 days before, but book earlier for December)
Shortlist and enquire with 3–5 ceremony locations in Edinburgh
Shortlist and enquire with 3–5 independent celebrants
Shortlist and book accommodation for 4–5 Dec (early Dec = festive market season, book early)
Confirm ceremony venue booking + deposit
Confirm celebrant booking + deposit
Shortlist and enquire with 3–5 elopement-experienced photographers
Research and shortlist restaurants for private dining, 6 covers
Book photographer
Book restaurant / private dining
Decide on outfits and start alterations lead time
Book hair & makeup trial (if wanted)
Choose florist and confirm bouquet/buttonhole style
Decide on rings — order/resize if needed (allow 4–6 weeks)
Finalise flowers order
Draft ceremony structure and running order with celebrant
Write personal vows — first drafts
Choose readings (if any) and who reads them
Finalise ceremony script with celebrant
Book guest travel/accommodation logistics (if you are coordinating it)
Share itinerary and dress code with guests
Confirm dietary requirements for the meal
Confirm final numbers with all suppliers
Pay outstanding deposits/balances
Check December weather contingency for photos (backup indoor/covered locations)
Confirm transport for ceremony day
Final fittings
Reconfirm all suppliers by phone/email
Print/prepare vows, script, reading cards
Pack: outfits, rings, documents (if legal), gifts
Travel to Edinburgh
Hair & makeup / getting ready
First look / pre-ceremony photos
Ceremony
Photography around Edinburgh
Private dining celebration

script.title: Reading(s)
script.content: See the Readings section below for full text.

Ceremony location.subject: Enquiry — intimate symbolic ceremony, 5 December, 6 people
Ceremony location.body:
Hello,

We're planning a symbolic name-changing ceremony in Edinburgh on 5 December — this is not a legal marriage or traditional wedding, but a personal and meaningful ceremony with the same feel. We'll have 6 people total including a celebrant and would love a beautiful, intimate space.

Could you let us know:

- Availability on 5 December
- Whether you host small symbolic ceremonies like this (relaxed, personal, not a traditional wedding package)
- Approximate cost for a 1–2 hour booking
- Whether we can bring our own independent celebrant
- Any restrictions around photography

We'd love to hear more about what's possible.

Thank you,

Celebrant.subject: Enquiry — celebrant for symbolic name-changing ceremony, 5 December
Celebrant.body:
Hello,

We're planning a symbolic name-changing ceremony in Edinburgh on 5 December — not a legal marriage, but a deeply personal ceremony with the same emotional significance. We'd like it to feel intimate and meaningful rather than formal. We're an adult couple with 4 guests, 6 people in total.

We loved the tone of your work and wanted to ask:

- Your availability on 5 December
- Whether you have experience leading symbolic or non-legal ceremonies (name changes, vow renewals, commitment ceremonies)
- Whether you're able to personalise the ceremony around our own vows, readings, and an optional ring exchange
- Your fee and what's included
- How far in advance you'd want to meet and write the script together

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Thank you,

Accommodation.subject: Booking enquiry — 4–5 December, small group
Accommodation.body:
Hello,

We're looking to book accommodation in Edinburgh for the nights around 4–5 December, for our ceremony weekend. Could you let us know:

- Availability for those dates
- Room options and rates
- Whether a later checkout on 5 December would be possible (getting ready for a ceremony that day)

Thank you,

Photographer.subject: Enquiry — elopement-style coverage, Edinburgh, 5 December
Photographer.body:
Hello,

We're having an intimate name-changing ceremony in Edinburgh on 5 December (6 people total) and love your elopement/micro-wedding work. Could you let us know:

- Availability on 5 December
- Packages and approximate pricing for a few hours' coverage
- Whether you have experience shooting in Edinburgh in winter light
- Turnaround time for edited images

Thank you,

Flowers.subject: Enquiry — small ceremony florals, 5 December
Flowers.body:
Hello,

We're planning a small, intimate ceremony in Edinburgh on 5 December and are looking for simple, seasonal florals — likely a bouquet and a buttonhole or two. Could you share:

- Availability for 5 December
- Approximate pricing for a small order like this
- What's in season in early December

Thank you,

Hair & makeup.subject: Enquiry — hair & makeup, 5 December, Edinburgh
Hair & makeup.body:
Hello,

We're looking for hair and makeup for a small ceremony in Edinburgh on the morning of 5 December. Could you let me know:

- Availability that morning
- Whether you travel to accommodation
- Pricing and how long it would take

Thank you,

Clothing.subject: Enquiry — outfit for intimate December ceremony
Clothing.body:
Hello,

I'm looking for an outfit for a small, relaxed ceremony in Edinburgh on 5 December. Could you tell me:

- Availability for a fitting in the coming weeks
- Typical alteration lead times
- Anything you'd recommend for a December ceremony (weather, layering)

Thank you,

Restaurant / private dining.subject: Private dining enquiry — 6 covers, evening of 5 December
Restaurant / private dining.body:
Hello,

We're celebrating an intimate ceremony in Edinburgh and would love to book a private or semi-private space for 6 people on the evening of 5 December. Could you let us know:

- Availability that evening
- Options for private/set dining for a small group
- Approximate cost per head
- Whether you could accommodate a short toast/speech

Thank you,

Transport.subject: Enquiry — transport for small ceremony party, 5 December
Transport.body:
Hello,

We need transport in Edinburgh on 5 December for a small ceremony party (up to 6 people), likely between accommodation, ceremony location and a restaurant. Could you share:

- Availability on 5 December
- Vehicle options for this group size
- Approximate pricing for a few short journeys across the day

Thank you,
